name: InTerFeRenCe
author: LiquidoxGMD
description: Go over the robot portal as the UFO at 13.9%. Navigate through the following gameplay as the UFO (make sure to touch the orbs or you will die) until 22% where you can spam above the level after touching the last blue pad (you can also fall above the level as the reverse gravity UFO at 17% and 19%. Stay near the ceiling until the end from there, and then fall or spam at the endscreen (depending on your gravity).
